2013 RAV4 Limited
$6,500 - 81416

Okay friends… you all know me. And if you know me, you know I am absolutely heartbroken to be writing this. 😂

I LOVE this car.

But apparently my wonderful real estate clients have decided it is officially time for their agent to level up the wheels. So, after a very gentle intervention, I’m letting my trusty RAV4 go.

And honestly, the ONLY reason she is leaving me is because I’m trading up for another RAV4. A 2019, because when you find a good thing, you stick with it. ❤️

So if you’re looking for an affordable, dependable, AWD daily driver without the brand-new-car price tag, this girl might be exactly what you’ve been looking for.

I bought her with about 60,000 miles on her, and she has spent the last several years doing what I ask of her: driving all over the place for real estate, hauling me from showing to showing, and generally being one heck of a reliable vehicle.

She now has 232,000 miles, and if you know Toyotas, you know that’s not necessarily the end of the road. She runs strong, has been well maintained right here in town at Kwiki Tire Service, and I have a solid list of service records that will go with her.

She just had her oil changed this week, too, so she’s ready for her next adventure.

What she’s got:

• 2013 Toyota RAV4 Limited AWD
• 232,000 miles
• Heated leather seats
• Power moonroof
• Push-button start
• Dual-zone climate control
• Bluetooth
• Clean title in hand
• Freshly detailed inside and out
• Spruce Mica deep dark green exterior
• Leather/premium interior
• Lots of life and a whole lot of history left in her

And because I believe in telling the whole story…

She has a few little character traits. 😂

The 2nd-to-3rd gear rumble: There’s a slight little rumble when she shifts between 2nd and 3rd. I had it checked out, and there’s nothing wrong with the vehicle. It has been doing this literally since I bought her at 60,000 miles. So at this point, I think it’s just part of her personality. She’s had this little quirk her entire life with me.

The back hatch: Sometimes the power hatch opens beautifully. Other times, she prefers that you open it manually. We respect her boundaries. 😂

The sunroof: It opens and closes, but when you’re closing it, you need to give it a little helping hand as it moves forward. Again… character.

The driver’s side mirror: A little loose after a brief disagreement with the car wash, but it is still fully functional.

The exterior: There are a few light scratches from my dogs enthusiastically greeting me over the years. They were just happy to see me. ❤️

So no, she isn’t brand new. She has 232,000 miles and a few stories to tell.

But she has been my dependable workhorse for years, she’s been maintained, she’s AWD, she’s comfortable, she’s loaded up with the Limited features, and she’s ready for someone else to put some miles on her.

If you need an affordable vehicle that can get you where you need to go without spending a fortune, come take a look at her.

I’d really love to see her go to someone who will appreciate her as much as I have.

And please… somebody give my girl a good home. I’m already emotional enough about this. 😂❤️🤣
